final_looks.text: Scalping in a SIDEWAYS market (neither rising nor falling): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 0.50% / target 1.00% (1:2), else exit 30 minutes after entry.

Scalping in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); exit 10 minutes after entry.

Intraday in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 1.00% / target 3.00% from entry (1:3), else exit at 15:15.

Scalping in a FALLING market (NIFTY below a falling 50-day average): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 0.50% / target 1.50% (1:3), else exit 30 minutes after entry.

Scalping in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); exit 15 minutes after entry.

Scalping in a SIDEWAYS market (neither rising nor falling): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 0.30% / target 0.90% (1:3), else exit 30 minutes after entry.

Scalping in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 2% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); exit 15 minutes after entry.

Scalping in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); exit when a 1-minute close crosses back through the session VWAP, at the latest 30 minutes after entry.

Swing in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when 5-day delivery % >= its 60-day mean + 10 points and a positive 20-day return, buy the stock at the next session's open (longs in delivery (CNC), shorts in stock futures); stop 8% / target 16% on the daily range (1:2), at the latest after 60 sessions.

promoted.text: Intraday in a HIGH-VOLATILITY market (India VIX in the top quarter of its last year): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 1.00% / target 3.00% from entry (1:3), else exit at 15:15.
